what_you_believe_happened: Signed in as owner. Opened Settings (Team & Roles), scrolled down to the 'Manager approval limit' card, typed 50000 in 'Limit per entry (₹)', clicked Save limits. A toast 'Manager approval limits saved.' appeared and the field retained 50000 with a helper line '₹50,000'. Meera Manager shows 'follows the limit above'.
incorrect_navigation_attempts: Clicked Money first (Books page) before returning to Settings
unnecessary_steps: Scrolling down a long Team & Roles page to reach the limit card
confusing_terminology: 'Limit per entry' vs 'Monthly total for each Manager' -> unclear whether monthly is required
'Settings' badge '!' -> unexplained, relates to two-factor warning
missing_feedback: Page jumps back to top after saving, so the saved value is not seen next to the toast; toast is brief and in a corner
unexpected_behaviour: Sidebar shows 'admin' and 'StudioOS Administrator' while signed in as owner
Page scrolled to top after Save
visual_issues: Manager approval limit card is hidden far below the team table, no link or heading near top
accessibility_issues: Not tested with keyboard beyond Enter on sign-in; toast is transient and may be missed by screen readers
observations: Feature is reasonably discoverable because Settings is flagged and the card has a clear name, and the help text explains the rule well. Placement below a long table is the main weakness.
